title: Reserve Then Build
prompt: Implement `squares` so it produces n values 1..n into the output vector using **at most one allocation**: reserve the exact capacity before writing. `push_back` in a loop after reserving is fine.

tests.name: values and single allocation
tests.hint: out.reserve(n) before the loop — a growing vector reallocates O(log n) times.

tests.name: large n stays at one allocation
tests.hint: reserve(10000) then push_back n times — no reallocation path is ever taken.
